import pytest
from isort.place import _is_namespace_package
from pathlib import Path

def test_is_namespace_package_no_init():
    path = Path('test_package')  # Assume test_package exists
    src_extensions = frozenset(['py'])
    assert not _is_namespace_package(path, src_extensions)


def test_is_namespace_package_with_init_no_declaration():
    path = Path('namespace_package_with_init')  # Assume it has __init__.py without declare_namespace
    init_file = path / '__init__.py'
    init_file.write_text('')  # Create an empty __init__.py
    src_extensions = frozenset(['py'])
    assert not _is_namespace_package(path, src_extensions)


def test_is_namespace_package_with_init_declaration():
    path = Path('namespace_package_with_init_decl')  # Assume it has __init__.py with declare_namespace
    init_file = path / '__init__.py'
    init_file.write_text('__import__("pkg_resources").declare_namespace(__name__)')
    src_extensions = frozenset(['py'])
    assert _is_namespace_package(path, src_extensions)


def test_is_namespace_package_with_files():
    path = Path('namespace_package_with_files')  # Assume it has files but no __init__.py
    path.mkdir()
    (path / 'module.py').write_text('print(1)')
    src_extensions = frozenset(['py'])
    assert not _is_namespace_package(path, src_extensions)


def test_is_namespace_package_with_valid_files_and_init():
    path = Path('namespace_package_valid')  # Assume it has files and an init file with valid declaration
    path.mkdir()
    (path / '__init__.py').write_text('__path__ = __import__("pkgutil").extend_path(__path__, __name__)')
    (path / 'module.py').write_text('print(1)')
    src_extensions = frozenset(['py'])
